text: APPROVE. The patch extracts `TryList`, `ReadEntries` and `EnqueueSubdirectories` with the same control flow (the `maxFiles` break still falls through to subdirectory enqueueing, and a failed listing still records the directory as unread and skips it), which brings `Files` well under 15. The `CHA0004` pragma now covers the new helpers, so the build should stay clean. I could not see the declared types of `files` and `unread` in the unchanged part of the file, so I assumed they match the new parameter types; the build is the check for that.
